description.value: Dana Pani Indian Cuisine is a North Indian restaurant in the Queensborough neighbourhood of New Westminster, offering a broad menu of tandoori specialities, biryanis, curries, and freshly baked breads. The kitchen is notable for its range of both meat and vegetarian dishes, from classic Butter Chicken to Paneer Stuffed Chana Bhatura, with wraps and rice bowls also available for quick meals. Touring cyclists can order pickup directly through the restaurant's own website.

address.value: 805 Boyd Street, J120, New Westminster, BC V3M 5X2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant is open and taking orders at 805 Boyd Street J120, New Westminster, matching OSM. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's prominent 'Order now' / pickup flow. The website lists extensive vegetarian menu sections ('Vegetarian specialities', 'Vegetarian Appetizers', 'Veggie Wrap', 'Veggie Curry Rice Bowl', paneer dishes), confirming vegetarian options. No phone number appears in OSM or on the website; only an email address (danapaniindian@gmail.com) is listed. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities is present in either source.
concerns: No phone number is available in OSM or on the website; only an email address (danapaniindian@gmail.com) is listed. Directory listing will have no phone contact.
